name: api-client
description: A free, local-first API client for VS Code, in development. Today it imports Thunder Client collections and environments into plain .http files for REST Client, httpYac and the JetBrains HTTP Client. No account, no telemetry.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Importing writes files into the workspace and reads data from other folders, so it needs a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The imported files are written with the file system of the machine the extension runs on.

commands.title: Import from Thunder Client (step by step)...

viewsWelcome.contents:
Move your Thunder Client collections and environments to plain .http files.
[Open the importer](command:apiClient.importThunder)
Nothing is written until you press Import. Local only: no account, no network, no telemetry.
